slides.title: "Quality at *affordable prices*" is not a brand.
slides.sub: It's what every business on your street says.

caption:
Walk down any street in Nairobi and count the signs that promise quality at affordable prices.

When everyone makes the same promise, nobody hears it. Customers fall back on price, and you end up in a race to the bottom.

A brand is a reason to pick you that has nothing to do with being cheapest.

What's one thing customers thank you for that has nothing to do with price? Tell us in the comments.
